name: Public Joint Stock Company Moscow City Telephone Network
summary: Public Joint Stock Company Moscow City Telephone Network provides telecommunications services in Russia. It operates through MGTS Service and Other, and MGTS Commercial segments. The company offers telecommunication services; communication services, including internet access, IP telephony, digital television, and mobile communications through a virtual operator (MVNO) model on MTS networks; and office and home management services, such as cloud video surveillance, which is involved to provide internet and implement video surveillance in educational institutions. Public Joint Stock Company Moscow City Telephone Network was founded in 1882 and is based in Moscow, Russia. Public Joint Stock Company Moscow City Telephone Network  is a subsidiary of Mobile TeleSystems Public Joint Stock Company.
